question_text: A DPWH crew of 6 workers can finish a road repair in 24 days. After 6 days, 2 more workers join. How many total days will the entire project take?

hint_ladder.title: Worker-Days ang Sukat
hint_ladder.text: Isipin mo ang total work na kailangan bilang 'worker-days.' Multiply workers by days: 6 × 24 = 144 worker-days. 'Yan ang constant mo.

hint_ladder.title: Bawasan ang Nagawa na
hint_ladder.text: Sa unang 6 days, may 6 workers kaya 6×6=36 worker-days na nagawa. Natitira: 144−36=108 worker-days.

hint_ladder.title: Hatiin sa Bagong Crew
hint_ladder.text: Dumami ang workers sa 8. Kaya hatiin ang 108 sa 8 para makuha ang extra days: 108÷8=13.5. Ito ang karagdagang araw.

hint_ladder.title: Idagdag ang Unang 6 Days
hint_ladder.text: Ang tanong: total days ng buong project. So 6 (naunang araw) + 13.5 = 19.5 days. 'Yan ang sagot.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 16 seems right if you simply divide 24 by 1.5, missing the 6 days of already-done work.

B.text: You might have chosen B because 24-6=18, but this ignores that more workers speed up the remaining job.

C.text: Correct. Total 144 worker-days, after 36 done leaves 108, with 8 workers takes 13.5 more days, total 19.5 days.

D.text: You might have chosen D because an incorrect scaling factor was applied to the new crew size, underestimating the speedup.

next_time_rule: Pag multi-stage work, find total worker-days muna. Subtract nagawa, then divide sa new crew size. Parang pizza: buo muna, then tira, then hati.
deconstruct_text:
Tara, imagine natin na ikaw ang Barangay Captain sa isang road repair project. Isang DPWH crew ng 6 na workers ang kayang tapusin 'to in 24 days. So ang total work ay 6 × 24 = 144 worker-days. Fixed 'yan, parang budget ng barangay.

Pagkatapos ng 6 days, ang 6 workers ay nakagawa na ng 6×6=36 worker-days. So ang natitirang trabaho ay 144−36=108 worker-days. Kaya may 2 pang workers na dumating, making it 8 workers.

Ngayon, 8 workers na sila. Ang additional days = 108 ÷ 8 = 13.5 days. Huwag kalimutan ang unang 6 days. Kaya total project days = 6 + 13.5 = 19.5 days. Kaya ang sagot ay 19.5.

**Watch-Out Zone: proportion_type_error** in play. Don't just subtract 24-6; use worker...
